tools.name: hab_list_emitters
tools.title: List HAB emitters
tools.description: List the notional radar emitter types in the HAB EMSO seminar model (fixed, marine, airborne) with frequency, power, pulse width and scan. Call this first to get valid emitter IDs. Returns JSON. All values are NOTIONAL.

tools.name: hab_intercept_range
tools.title: HAB intercept range
tools.description: Maximum range (km) at which a high-altitude balloon with a notional Philowave-class filter-bank detector detects a radar's pulses: the smaller of the one-way link-budget range and the radio horizon. Returns JSON.

emitterId.description: Emitter ID from hab_list_emitters, e.g. MAR-X1

lobe.description: 'main' for mainbeam illumination (scan-timing geolocation) or 'side' for sidelobes (needed at 3+ balloons for TDOA)

tools.name: hab_geolocation_accuracy
tools.title: HAB geolocation accuracy
tools.description: Predicted geolocation accuracy (CEP50 in meters; -1 if not observable) of an emitter by nHAB balloons evenly spaced on a ring around the area-of-interest center, accounting for which balloons can hear the emitter. Returns JSON.

ringRadius_km.description: Ring radius around the AOI center, km

east_km.description: Emitter east offset from AOI center, km

north_km.description: Emitter north offset from AOI center, km

tools.name: hab_evaluate_design
tools.title: Evaluate HAB constellation design
tools.description: Cost, coverage and payload SWaP of a balloon EMSO constellation over a 400 x 400 km littoral area with fixed, marine and airborne radars (notional model). Takes about 1-2 s. Returns JSON with cost_USD, effGeoCoverage, per-class coverage, fracOnStation, payload mass/power and feasible (mass <= 4 kg, power <= 25 W).

dfOption.description: true to add amplitude-comparison direction finding (needed for airborne ESA radars; ~4x channel hardware)

altBandHalf_km.description: Altitude-control authority, +- km around 20 km float, 3-4.5

tools.name: hab_identify_emitter
tools.title: Identify emitter from pulse features
tools.description: Match pulse descriptor features a filter-bank detector can measure against the notional emitter library. Returns the filter channel and the top three matches with scores 0-1 as JSON.

frequency_GHz.description: Carrier frequency, 2-18 GHz (only the 500 MHz channel is used)

pri_us_list.description: PRI value(s) in microseconds as comma-separated text, e.g. '500' or '950,980,1000,1020,1050'

scanPeriod_s.description: Scan or rotation period in seconds; 0 if unknown

tools.name: hab_run_core_tests
tools.title: Run HAB library regression tests
tools.description: Run the 13 regression tests of the HAB EMSO pw library and report PASS/FAIL for each (about 30 s).
